board_name: Karnataka School Board Ecosystem (KSEAB & Karnataka Pre-University Education)

KSEAB.name: Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board (KSEAB)
KSEAB.jurisdiction: Secondary Education (Class 9 Academic Evaluation & Class 10 Secondary School Leaving Certificate / SSLC Examination)

PUE.name: Department of School Education (Pre-University) / Karnataka PUC System
PUE.jurisdiction: Higher Secondary / Pre-University Education (Class 11 = I PUC & Class 12 = II PUC)

class_9.examination_status: Annual School-Level Summative Assessment (SA-2) & CCE Framework
class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation, SATS Enrolment for SSLC

progression_to_class_10.rule: Progression to Class 10 requires passing Class 9 Summative Assessment (SA-2) under DSEL / KSEAB guidelines, maintaining minimum 75% attendance, and valid student SATS (Student Achievement Tracking System) enrolment.

class_10.service_type: Public Secondary Board Examination, 6-Paper Pattern Verification, Practice & Model Papers

paper_pattern_structure.pattern_description: Six-Paper Pattern: First Language (100 marks theory + 25 internal = 125 marks max), Second Language (80 marks theory + 20 internal = 100 marks max), Third Language (80 marks theory + 20 internal = 100 marks max), Mathematics (80 marks theory + 20 internal = 100 marks max), Science (80 marks theory + 20 internal = 100 marks max), Social Science (80 marks theory + 20 internal = 100 marks max).
paper_pattern_structure.exam_duration: 3 hours 15 minutes for 100-mark First Language & Core Subjects (including 15 mins reading time); 2 hours 45 minutes for Second & Third Languages.

core_academic_subjects.name: Social Science (ಸಮಾಜ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ - History, Pol Sci, Sociology, Geog, Econ, Business)

passing_criteria.minimum_passing_marks: 35 marks out of 100 (28 in theory + 7 in internal for core subjects; 44 out of 125 for First Language).

class_11.examination_status: Pre-University Certificate - First Year (I PUC) Annual College Examination
class_11.service_type: PUE Administered I PUC Annual Examination, Foundation for II PUC, Six-Subject Framework

progression_to_class_12.rule: Progression to II PUC requires appearing in and qualifying the I PUC annual examination in all six chosen subjects, maintaining minimum 75% attendance, and subject continuity without unapproved combination changes.

class_12.examination_name: Pre-University Certificate - Second Year (II PUC) Board Examination
class_12.service_type: Public Higher Secondary Board Examination, Six-Subject Rule (2 Languages + 4 Optionals)
class_12.six_subject_rule: Under official Karnataka PUC regulations, every student studies exactly six subjects in both I PUC and II PUC: Two languages under Part I (compulsorily chosen from the scheduled 10 languages) and Four optional subjects under Part II.

commerce.name: Business Studies, Accountancy, Statistics, Basic Mathematics
Business Studies, Accountancy, Statistics, Computer Science
Basic Mathematics, Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy

class_12.scheme_of_examination: Total Aggregate: 600 Marks (100 Marks per subject across 6 subjects). Laboratory subjects feature 70 Theory + 30 Practical marks; Non-lab subjects feature 80 Theory + 20 Internal Assessment marks.

passing_criteria.distinction_threshold: Distinction (>= 85%), First Class (60% to < 85%), Second Class (50% to < 60%), Pass Class (35% to < 50%), Fail (< 35%).
